aspect: Proximity did the work, and proximity goes
description: Nobody decides to stop being friends. One person moves and the thing that sustained it - being in the same place repeatedly - is simply absent.

aspect: The organising falls to whoever minds most
description: Adult friendship runs on someone doing the scheduling, and that person eventually notices they are the only one doing it.

aspect: SCENARIO - the group chat that went quiet
description: Six people, fourteen years. Someone had a baby, someone moved, the messages thinned to birthdays. Nothing happened. It is simply over.
